# Contributing

This project is maintained by [LOC](https://github.com/loc-oss) and follows our
[Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Opening issues

If you have a question, a feature request, or think you've found a bug, please
open an issue. Before opening an issue, **use GitHub's search bar** to make sure
there isn't an existing (open or closed) issue for your problem.

## Proposing and making changes

### Finding something to work on

Browse the [issues](https://github.com/loc-oss/xi-editor/issues). If you can't
find anything there, feel free to open a discussion or create an issue
describing what you'd like to work on.

### Before you open your PR

Before pressing the 'Create pull request' button:

- **Run the tests**. You can run all checks locally with the
  `rust/run_all_checks` script.
- **Add a message for your reviewers**. Explain any non-obvious decisions.
- **Be your own first reviewer**. Look over your PR diff one last time.

### Review process

Every non-trivial pull request goes through review. All pull requests must be
approved by a maintainer before they are merged, and must pass CI.
